title: Boat Motor Cover 420D – Full Coverage for Outboard Motors
descriptionHtml:
Soon the boat is on land again – and the motor sits unprotected until spring

Rain, snow and frost work away at the outboard for six months. And a bare motor on a boat in storage is the first thing a thief spots from the road.

A full winter cover for the outboard

Pull the cover over the whole motor – from the cowl down over the leg – and tighten the strap around the middle. 420D Oxford fabric keeps weather and dirt out for the whole storage period, and a covered motor is a much duller prize than an open one.

Features

  • The motor winters under cover – covers from cowl to leg, not just the top
  • Lasts a whole winter outside – hard-wearing 420D Oxford fabric against rain, snow and UV
  • Less tempting to thieves – no one can see which motor is underneath
  • Fits your motor – nine sizes from 0–5 hp to 250–350 hp, see the size guide
  • On before the boat is even strapped down – pulled over and tightened, no tools

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
